name: Kyoto Sennen Monogatari - Cosmology of KYOTO
original_name: 京都千年物語 Cosmology of KYOTO
source:
Step into the mind of an ancient Japanese person in the Heian period in ancient Kyoto. Live their fears, fight their demons, and understand their history and legends by actually experiencing them first hand.

"There is the sense, illusory but seductive, that one could wander this world indefinitely. This is a wonderful game." - Roger Ebert. 

[From [url=http://www.wired.com/wired/archive/2.09/streetcred.html]Wired[/url]]
translation:
踏入古都京都平安时代一名古代日本人的内心。亲身经历他们的恐惧，与心魔战斗，并理解他们的历史与传说。

“有一种虚幻却诱人的感觉，仿佛人可以永远在这个世界中漫游。这是一款精彩的游戏。”——罗杰·埃伯特

[来自[url=http://www.wired.com/wired/archive/2.09/streetcred.html]Wired[/url]]
